import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {

    static class Input {
        long mod;
        int n, m;

        boolean read(Scanner sc) {
            if (sc.hasNextInt()) {
                n = sc.nextInt();
                m = sc.nextInt();
                mod = sc.nextLong();
                return true;
            }
            return false;
        }
    }

    static class Data extends Input {
        long ans;

        void write() {
            System.out.println(ans);
        }
    }

    static class Solution extends Data {
        static final int N = 500;
        long[][] c = new long[N + 1][N + 1];
        long[] a_fs = new long[N + 1];
        long[] a_sc = new long[N + 1];
        long[][][] d_fs = new long[N + 2][N + 1][2]; // Using 3D array for (d[i][j].fs, d[i][j].sc)
        long[][][] d_sc = new long[N + 2][N + 1][2];

        long pw(long x, long y) {
            long res = 1;
            long base = x % mod;
            while (y > 0) {
                if ((y & 1) == 1) {
                    res = (res * base) % mod;
                }
                base = (base * base) % mod;
                y >>= 1;
            }
            return res;
        }

        long inv(long x) {
            return pw(x, mod - 2);
        }

        long ss(int x) {
            return (long) x * (x + 1) / 2;
        }

        void solve() {
            for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j <= n; j++) {
                    if (i == 0 || j == 0) {
                        c[i][j] = 1;
                    } else {
                        c[i][j] = (c[i - 1][j] + c[i][j - 1]) % mod;
                    }
                }
            }

            // Initialize a
            for (int i = 0; i <= m; i++) {
                a_fs[i] = 0;
                a_sc[i] = 0;
            }
            a_fs[0] = 1;
            a_sc[0] = 0;

            for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) {
                    long cur_fs = (a_fs[j] * a_fs[i - 1 - j]) % mod;
                    long cur_sc = (a_sc[j] * a_fs[i - 1 - j] + a_fs[j] * a_sc[i - 1 - j]) % mod;
                    cur_sc = (cur_sc * (i + 1) + (ss(j) + ss(i - 1 - j)) * cur_fs) % mod;
                    cur_fs = (cur_fs * (i + 1)) % mod;
                    cur_fs = (cur_fs * c[j][i - 1 - j]) % mod;
                    cur_sc = (cur_sc * c[j][i - 1 - j]) % mod;
                    a_fs[i] = (a_fs[i] + cur_fs) % mod;
                    a_sc[i] = (a_sc[i] + cur_sc) % mod;
                }
            }

            // Initialize d
            for (int i = 0; i <= n + 1; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j <= m; j++) {
                    d_fs[i][j][0] = 0;
                    d_sc[i][j][0] = 0;
                    d_fs[i][j][1] = 0;
                    d_sc[i][j][1] = 0;
                }
            }
            d_fs[0][0][0] = 1;
            d_sc[0][0][0] = 0;

            for (int i = 0; i <= n + 1; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j <= m; j++) {
                    for (int k = 0; k <= Math.min(n - i, m - j); k++) {
                        long cur_fs = (a_fs[k] * d_fs[i][j][0]) % mod;
                        long cur_sc = (a_sc[k] * d_fs[i][j][0] + a_fs[k] * d_sc[i][j][0]) % mod;
                        cur_fs = (cur_fs * c[j][k]) % mod;
                        cur_sc = (cur_sc * c[j][k]) % mod;
                        int ni = i + k + 1;
                        int nj = j + k;
                        d_fs[ni][nj][0] = (d_fs[ni][nj][0] + cur_fs) % mod;
                        d_sc[ni][nj][0] = (d_sc[ni][nj][0] + cur_sc) % mod;
                    }
                }
            }

            ans = d_sc[n + 1][m][0];
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        Solution sol = new Solution();

        while (true) {
            if (!sol.read(sc)) {
                break;
            }
            sol.solve();
            sol.write();
            // No explicit clear needed as we reinitialize in solve
        }
        sc.close();
    }
}
